Preserve cost-window and day-column identity across refreshed usage data. Extend the real-Gateway usage benchmark with native WebKit comparisons, isolated diagnostics, frozen package verification, and bounded synthetic captures. Chromium qualification of the analytics changes improves all four model/filter CPU cells; final cost-window comparison is pending. * test(perf): keep Usage fixture dates consistent across roles Choose the date once in the driver so long comparisons remain equivalent across UTC midnight. Capture the cost-window panel after all timed interactions for before-and-after review.

items.title: test(tts): prepare runtime config for summary selection (#188862)
items.summary: test(tts): prepare runtime config for summary selection (#188862) ## What Problem This Solves Fixes the real TTS summary-selection test failing with “Runtime config is not prepared” after #188720. ## User Impact This is a test-fixture repair with no user-visible behavior change. The existing summary and model-selection assertions remain unchanged. ## Why This Change Was Made Publish the fixture's config before real model acquisition and clear it after each test. This preserves #188720's live Codex settings lookup, including worker-hosted binary ownership, without changing production support behavior. ## Evidence - The unchanged test reproduces the same error on Node 24.22.1 and pinned Bun `1.4.4-canary.1+191755ec1`. The repair and two TTS siblings pass all 24 tests on each runtime (70.15 s and 53.53 s, including wrapper/setup). - Scoped typecheck, type-aware lint, format, test-line, timeout-race, max-lines and mock-export checks pass. No test ceiling, baseline or allocation changes. - Fresh independent full-context P0–P2 autoreview: scoped-clean, no findings. Existing assertions are byte-identical. Focused CI-boundary proof; no live-model or whole-shard replay claim. Requested by @steipete ## Work sessions [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/b5679712-7777-4ff7-a05a-81c1efab2069) Co-authored-by: steipete Co-authored-by: Raj Muppala

Align the remaining plugins to the version the root already ships. No new upstream version enters the lockfile; the unused 0.26.14 entries drop out.
